notes.title: Shorebound Update 0.5.54.105
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355173/1497c53cb1dcadb2ad01501d92edb75f83666305.png[/img]

[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Pet System:[/b] Pets can now be leveled up by feeding them! A leveled pet can accompany you into dungeons and help during settlement activities.
[*] [b]Steam Achievements:[/b] I've added a bunch of Steam achievements, many of them hidden like easter eggs, waiting for you to discover!
[*] [b]Russian Localization:[/b] The game is now available in Russian!
[*] [b]Multi-Jumping:[/b] Players can now jump multiple times... because it's fun :)
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Bosses in Lavalands are now faster and more challenging.
[*] Increased the brightness of street lights.
[*] In Greenlands, music will now play randomly instead of looping the same track.
[*] The harvest key prompt now shows when crops are ready.
[*] Updated the Gold Mine model in Greenlands.
[*] Reduced the delay between Skeleton Archer shots.
[*] Resources can no longer be crafted.
[*] Increased the drop rate for leg armor.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Escape menu could cause the game to freeze with no way to exit.
[*] Removed excessive bloom from ghost and creep skills.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in Lavalands.
[*] Nighttime during overcast weather is no longer excessively dark.
[*] Fixed loud wind noise during heavy rain.
[*] Settlement music volume now correctly adjusts based on your settings.
[*] Fixed a bug where pickup tool text would stay on screen.
[*] Snipers now properly target the nearest enemies.
[*] Item comparison UI now works as intended.
[*] Bait count now displays correctly while fishing.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could accidentally fish while interacting with UI elements.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the fishing animation.
[/list]

notes.title: Shorebound Update 0.5.50.85
notes.content:
Shorebound Version 0.5.50.85

Additions
• Random dungeon events have been added to the Greenlands
• A weather system has been added to the settlement
• New handcrafted soundtracks for all maps, including the main menu
• A gamma setting has been added
• New weapon type: Staff
• New resource: Softshard
• Rarity colors now display on pickup
• Inventory now shows green arrows for better equipment
• "Select All" button added for quick selling of trash items

Changes
• Increased top-down camera field of view
• Design updates to the Greenlands
• Perfect mining hits now give extra stones
• Faster interaction for teleporters and main building
• Environmental and random music added to settlements
• Equipment now grants flat Defense and Health Regen instead of percentage
• Increased crafting requirements for Bow Rank 3
• Inventory slots increased from 28 to 36
• General optimization improvements

Bug Fixes
• Foliage removal works again
• Fixed building and farm plot removal issues
• Fireball can now damage trees and mines
• Crafting UI shows item names on hover
• You can now build on top of tables
• Building placement cancellation fixed
• Fixed oversized resource icons after dungeon completion
• Leaderboard now highlights your username correctly
• Fixed the Ghost and Earth Spikes Achievement

notes.title: Day 2 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
First off, I want to say sorry to anyone who ran into issues while playing. I’ve been reading your feedback and spent the last two days working on improvements. Here's what’s new:


[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new level-up upgrade for Axe: it now spawns extra projectiles
[*] Introduced a Hammer tool that lets you move or remove buildings
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Skeleton Guards now show attack indicators
[*] Settlement performance improved by about 15% overall
[*] Optimized Astral Smite for better performance
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with interaction mode while building
[*] Fireball level-up cards now correctly show amount and piercing
[*] No more spam interactions with the cat
[*] Magnet no longer picks up magnets
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (v0.3.38.62)
notes.content:
First of all, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks for your bug reports and feedback. In this version, we've fixed all reported bugs and made a significant change to the settlement view: it is now in third person instead of top down. This change aims to create a cozier atmosphere and open up more possibilities for gameplay improvements.

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] The settlement is now in third person view.
[*] Added leaderboards with expanded stats tracking.
[*] You can now run in the settlement by holding the Shift key.
[*] Swimming is now available.
[*] Placing buildings now includes sound effects and visual effects.
[*] Added a button in the escape menu to return to the main menu.
[*] Added a day and night cycle for the settlement.
[*] New settings: Invert Mouse option and mouse sensitivity adjustments.
[*] Added new animations for fishing.
[*] Added one new skill.
[*] Added a mirror for character customization.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Made significant graphical updates to the settlement.
[*] Rebalanced difficulty in the dungeon.
[*] Updated item equipping: drag and drop is now required instead of clicking.
[*] Fish prices have been increased.
[*] Reworked the building system.
[*] Inventory can now be opened with the I key.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies and resources no longer spawn beyond the map borders.
[*] Fixed an issue where leaderboards would crash due to many requests.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the enchantment altar to disappear after canceling its construction.
[*] Achievement progress now updates correctly after completing an achievement.
[*] Fixed an issue where moving farming plots falsely counted as extra progress in achievements.
[*] Default music volume is now balanced at game start.
[*] The seed count in the crafting menu updates properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the harvest timer would sometimes get stuck.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (v0.3.27.48)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo! We’re excited to share our Day One Update, which includes important fixes and a preview of what’s coming next.

We plan to release new content every 1–2 weeks (depending on the system we’re adding) and will share a full Roadmap soon. Here’s a quick look at some upcoming features:

[list]
[*] Equipment system
[*] Full third-person settlement gameplay
[*] Skill evolutions
[*] Unique skills for crafted weapons
[*] Landscape editing
[*] Random dungeon events
[*] A second map
[*] More decorations and buildings
[/list]

Patch Notes (v0.3.27.48)
[list]
[*] Fixed mutant movement during ranged and AoE attacks.
[*] Fixed dungeons not completing properly.
[*] Unlocking difficulties now works correctly.
[*] Balanced the Fuma Shuriken.
[*] Fixed the “Deal Bow Damage” achievement.
[*] Removed unused skill slots from the stats menu.
[/list]
